name: @amykit/plugin-file-tasks
description: Tasks as a directory of files: written by `amy btw`, by an editor, or by a hook.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it with the errand workflow, which reads its work from the tasks port this plugin mounts. A task is a file in a directory, written by amy btw, by an editor or by a hook, and a task that names no repository is about the configured default.
